ruling_text:
Dastjerdi vs. South Coast Medical Center for New Medicine, Inc.

Plaintiff's Motion for Preliminary Approval of Class Settlement
Plaintiff's motion for preliminary approval of class action settlement is
CONTINUED to April 8, 2026 at 1:30 p.m. in Department CX101 to permit the
parties to respond to the following item of concern. Any supplemental
briefing shall be filed on or before March 30, 2026. If a revised settlement
agreement and/or class notice is submitted, a redline showing all changes,
deletions and additions must be submitted as well.
The Court previously noted that the operative 2AC, which added a PAGA
claim, was filed one day after Plaintiff notified the LWDA of her PAGA claim.
The Court questioned whether Plaintiff had adequately exhausted her PAGA
claim. In response, Plaintiff cites Woodworth v. Loma Linda University
Medical Center (2023) 93 Cal.App.5th 1038 (erroneously cited as p. 1024) to
argue that the LWDA's subsequent failure to respond to her notice cured any
defect in exhaustion. Woodworth so holds in part VII.B of the opinion. But
per the introductory footnote, part VII isn't certified for publication. It
therefore may not be cited. (CRC 8.1110(c); 8.1115(a).) Plaintiff's subsequent
string-cite of non-binding federal district court cases appears to be copied
from the unpublished portion of Woodworth.
